crossRefs.note: The men of Israel said, “Have you seen this man who has come up? He has surely come up to defy Israel. The king will…

translations.web: The people answered him in this way, saying, “So shall it be done to the man who kills him.”
translations.bsb: The people told him about the offer, saying, “That is what will be done for the man who kills him.”
translations.kjv: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.
translations.asv: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.
